description: Use this to add an expense category to a group, with an emoji and a name.

emoji.description: An emoji shown beside the category's name.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

name.description: The category's name, such as Food or Rent.

position.description:
Its place in the category list, 1 first; omit to put it last. Only this category's number
changes: categories on the same number keep the order they were added in.

name: add_category
title: Add a category
